report.title: Add a "reblur" and move the "unblur" button to a more fixed position

plan.reported_actual: Once a sensitive memo has been unblurred it cannot be blurred again, and in a long memo the 'click to show sensitive content' button sits at the bottom, so the user has to scroll down to reach it.
missing: This is a feature request, not a bug report, so there is no defect to reproduce.
How is a memo marked sensitive in this version of Memos (which tag or setting)? The report does not say.
Where exactly should the re-blur button and the relocated unblur button go? The screenshots are the only description of the intended placement.
plan.summary: Feature request: add a re-blur button and move the unblur control for sensitive memos

verdict.headline: This does not look like something visible in a desktop browser UI.
